questions.stem: A historical case bar chart shows 12 votes for candidate A; what does bar height represent?

options.text: The number of votes for candidate A.

questions.explanation: Bar height shows the count 12. Percent, rank, and average are different measures.

questions.stem: A historical case scatter plot rises left to right; a student calls it negative association; find error.

options.text: It is negative because values increase.
Rising left to right means positive association.
Association cannot be determined from a plot.

questions.stem: A historical case line of best fit has slope 2; explain meaning.

answer.exemplar: For each one-unit increase in x, y increases by about 2 units on average.

questions.explanation: Slope 2 means y increases by 2 per unit x.

questions.stem: A historical case two-way table shows 15 people in cell (Yes, Male); what does 15 represent?
questions.explanation: Cell count is number of people with both attributes: 15.

questions.stem: A historical case has 4 categories of artifacts; minimum number of bars in a bar chart?
A historical case claims more rain causes more crops; data shows no link; is claim supported?

options.text: No, data does not support it.

questions.explanation: Data shows no link, so claim is unsupported.

questions.stem: A historical case uses 7^0; what is its value?
questions.explanation: Any nonzero number to the 0 power is 1.

questions.stem: A historical case computes 2^-3 as -8; find error.
A historical case circle chart shows a 90-degree sector; explain percent.

answer.exemplar: A full circle is 360 degrees, so 90/360=0.25=25 percent.

questions.stem: A historical case tracks temperature over days; which display is best?
questions.explanation: Line graph shows trend over time best.

questions.stem: A historical case claims X causes Y; data only shows correlation; find error.

options.text: No data can support any claim.
Causation requires an experiment, always impossible.

questions.explanation: Correlation alone does not establish causation.

questions.stem: A historical case simplifies (ab)^0; explain result.

answer.exemplar: Any nonzero base to the zero power is 1, so (ab)^0=1 when ab is not zero.

questions.stem: A historical case two-way table marginal total should be row sum; a student uses cell value; find error.
